covered_uses: Specified primary computing/network/infrastructure uses, including AI, blockchain, cryptocurrency mining, cloud, colocation, enterprise, hyperscale and edge, AND at least 25000 square feet aggregate defined Data Center Area
exemptions: Server rooms or IT infrastructure accessory to site principal use if aggregate accessory-use area is strictly less than 25000 square feet

thresholds.measurement_basis: Aggregate defined Data Center Area: computing equipment/infrastructure floor space, cooling/maintenance corridors and associated impervious surfaces including access ways, parking lots, transmission corridors and accessory buildings/structures
thresholds.scope: Second of two cumulative data-center definition conditions

locator: Reviewed North Berwick official source page 20
scope: Source transcription or proposed provisions; result certification does not establish operative legal force.
